name: UW-La Crosse at Luther Dual
headline: UW-La Crosse at Luther Dual
summary: Final: No. 5 UW-La Crosse men and No. 3 UW-La Crosse women both beat Luther in the Friday dual. Brady Norman won the men's 5K in 15:43.6 as the Eagles took the top ten places, and Ashley Wilson won the women's 5K in 18:40.1 with UW-La Crosse running 1-2-3-4-5-6-7.
